name: 51841-imageprefill-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~8B params: a 36-layer language tower and a 27-layer vision tower. Shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json, revision 0c351dd01ed87e9c1b53cbc748cba10e6187ff3b.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 20%, no cooldown, bound 320 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image+text: one 2048x2048 JPEG (content `gradient`, quality 85, seed 42) plus a 32-token question, 32 output tokens, one image per request. Prompt and output lengths are pinned (min=max). Images are row-index seeded, so no two requests carry the same pixels.
purpose: A visual question-answering service describing single high-resolution photos with short answers for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: vLLM at commit 7aa248fcfef5ba7a6bfb0ce314e328ce63abb9f9. The interpreter and the
# hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is this machine's answer and is NOT portable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 32
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request: 1` -- it is both the admission limit and what
# the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one and you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0

# COMPATIBILITY, not a workload choice. The startup FlashInfer autotune pass in this checkout
# imports a symbol that does not exist in the flashinfer this venv carries, and the engine dies
# during bring-up. Nothing in this deployment dispatches to FlashInfer. See configs/note.md.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
